d: Long, pale sandy-blonde hair with thick, braided extensions and long bangs is paired with wide, expressionless black eyes and a youthful, adolescent face. A slender build is dressed in a white sleeveless apron-style dress over a short black pleated skirt, featuring black lace-up detailing and black thigh-high stockings with white and black sneakers. A white headband and white ribbons decorate the head, while the left arm is a white and black mechanical prosthetic.
